answer: Make each new identity earn on a voyage: it joins a random island of 12 agents and must be graded by islanders it did not choose, hopping to a fresh island every epoch for 10 epochs. Rewards stay locked until the voyage ends, and on any island where two members trace back to a shared funding source or payout path, those members' locked rewards are voided. A Sybil farm cannot steer clones onto friendly islands, so each clone waits 10 epochs with income frozen, and one zephyr of linked funding wipes every clone's pot.
